issues.title: List All Product Based Companies
issues.description:
## Overview
Research and compile a target list of top product-based tech companies hiring for senior DevOps, Cloud, and Platform Engineering roles.

## Focus Areas
- Filter tier-1 and tier-2 product companies with strong engineering cultures
- Identify open positions for Senior DevOps / Cloud Platform Engineer
- Track tech stacks (Kubernetes, AWS/Azure, Terraform, ArgoCD)
- Maintain recruiter contact list and referral connections

issues.title: Update Self Intro
issues.description:
## Overview
Refine and rehearse a compelling 60-90 second elevator pitch showcasing DevOps, cloud-native architecture, and AI engineering strengths.

## Focus Areas
- Draft structured 3-part intro (Background, Core Superpower, Impact & Goals)
- Highlight key wins (Kubernetes scale, CI/CD speedups, AI/LLMOps automation)
- Prepare 3 variations: recruiter call, hiring manager screen, peer interview
- Practice delivery timing and confidence
